def parity(x: uint8) -> bool:
    """True when the byte has an odd number of set bits."""
    pre x >= 0 and x <= 255
    ex parity(0) == False
    ex parity(3) == False
    ex parity(7) == True
    ex parity(255) == False
    count: uint8 = 0
    n = x
    while n > 0:
        count += n & 1
        n = n >> 1
    return count % 2 == 1
